title: Heterogeneous Debate Engine: Identity-Grounded Cognitive Architecture for Resilient LLM-Based Ethical Tutoring
reasoning: The paper focuses on building and evaluating an LLM-based system for ethical tutoring and moral reasoning. It evaluates the system's performance using ethical frameworks such as Deontology, Utilitarianism, and Christian Virtue Ethics (theology), specifically utilizing dilemmas like the Trolley Problem to measure doctrinal fidelity and pedagogical effectiveness.
